title: Let the Guru's word lift you into real stature
summary: The Guru's word lifts the soul into true stature. Choose the practice that leaves the heart steadier, not louder.
takeaway: Choose the practice that leaves the heart steadier, not louder.
lifeApplication: Before reaching for a higher image, return to one instruction the Guru has already given. Stay there until the word steadies and lifts you from within.

source.shortMeaning: The Guru's word lifts the soul into true stature.
